speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis (Listeria monocytogenes infection).

The patient is a 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation presenting with sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. Given her pregnancy and the specific report of consuming ice cream three days prior to symptom onset, the clinical picture is highly suggestive of Listeriosis, a known risk associated with unpasteurized dairy products in pregnant women. I will now request specific test results to confirm the diagnosis.
